readout_other: pursuit-tracking task; resting-state EEG power and phase-locking value; resting-state fMRI (ReHo, ALFF, seed connectivity)
direction_notes: Single-arm. Beta power at CP3 fell during tFUS and recovered after, theta PLV rose in frontoparietal pairs, pursuit-tracking error fell after a single session, and fMRI showed reduced contralesional motor hyperactivity.
safety_notes: Participants were interviewed about adverse effects; no adverse reactions were reported. Thermal simulation predicted a maximum rise of 0.2 C.

timing.protocol_description: PRF 1000 Hz, duty cycle 20%, sonication duration 0.5 s, inter-stimulus interval 1 s; 480 pulse trains over 12 minutes. Two 12-minute sessions at least one hour apart, the second followed by resting-state fMRI.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Given the small sample size $( N = 6 )$ , all correlation analyses should be interpreted with caution, as they are susceptible to the influence of individual data points.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Subsequently, a second 12-minute tFUS session (tFUS-only) was conducted, immediately followed by a 10-minute resting-state fMRI scan.
